spec: Implement the shared deterministic helper and a real repository adapter per docs/test-impact/design.md sections 2–5, 7–10 and 13–14. Require explicit exact endpoints and enforce execution snapshot identity, including relevant worktree inputs and reliable detection of mutations. Discover and map actual runner targets, include changed tests, apply declared invalidation and full fallback rules, preserve original full workflows and gates, report separate impact, plan, execution and verification statuses, and implement compatible baseline receipts and receipt chaining. Missing or incompatible baseline expands execution to the full configured profile. Include meaningful acceptance tests for the snapshot, discovery, fallback, evidence, error and execution contracts. Select a representative project and runner through design; no model invocation in normal runs. The full design is binding. Work directly in this fork for an eventual upstream pull request; no separate product repository or subtree.
title: Build deterministic test planning, execution and evidence
